Method of Attack: Harvesting WiFi network information and device MAC addresses via Android OS internal system broadcasts (intents) without user permission
Listening to WifiManager's NETWORK_STATE_CHANGED_ACTION and WifiP2pManager's WIFI_P2P_THIS_DEVICE_CHANGED_ACTION intents to capture WiFi-related data
Bypassing Android permission system to access sensitive information without user prompts
Using harvested WiFi data to query public BSSID databases (WiGLE, SkyHook) to track user location
Impacted Systems: All versions of Android OS including forks such as Amazon FireOS
Attack Vector: Android OS internal system-wide broadcast intents
